source: https://www.acces-maroc.ma/, https://www.acces-maroc.ma/assets/docs/Conditions%20utilisation%20eVisa%20-%20An.pdf and https://www.acces-maroc.ma/assets/docs/Guide%20eVisa.pdf, read 2026-08-30. The live eligibility screen and official PDFs publish route questions, required documents, a 35 x 45 mm photo, JPG/JPEG/PDF attachments up to 1 MB and the application sequence. Authenticated text-field regexes, character limits and official error strings are not public, so no pattern or [[errors]] is used and no local validator is mounted.

eligibility_result.label: Entry eligibility result
eligibility_result.placeholder: No visa, consular visa, AEVM or eVisa
eligibility_result.help: Run the live checker before paying. The official guide says it can route the traveller to no visa, a consular visa, AEVM or eVisa.

nationality.label: Nationality/Country Citizenship
nationality.help: The live checker starts with the nationality of the passport that will be used for travel.

country_of_residence.label: Country of Usual Residence
country_of_residence.help: Residence can affect Category B eligibility. The residence permit must meet the current validity rule.

passport_type.label: Document type (Passport)
passport_type.help: Only ordinary passports are accepted for eVisa. Other travel-document holders are directed to an embassy or consulate.

purpose.label: Purpose of the Trip
purpose.help: The eVisa is issued for Tourism or Business. The live checker also asks whether the traveller is participating in an event.

supporting_status.label: Residence permit or supporting visa
supporting_status.placeholder: Only when Category B or C applies
supporting_status.help: Category B uses an eligible residence card or permit valid at least 180 days. Category C uses an eligible multiple-entry non-electronic visa valid at least 90 days.

name_and_birth.label: Surname, given name and date of birth
name_and_birth.help: The official note tells applicants to transcribe surname, given name and date of birth from the passport.

document_details.label: Passport and supporting-document details
document_details.placeholder: Number and validity of each document
document_details.help: Copy nationality, document number and validity from the passport, residence card or supporting visa used for eligibility.

email.label: Email and confirmation
email.help: The guide sends a secure application link to the entered email and uses the same address for tracking.

photo.label: Colour photo
photo.help: The official note requires a good-quality 35 x 45 mm colour photo taken within the last 6 months and showing facial features to ICAO standards.

passport_copy.label: Ordinary passport colour copy
passport_copy.help: Attach a clear colour copy of the valid ordinary passport pages showing identity and validity.

attachments.label: Supporting attachments
attachments.placeholder: JPG, JPEG or PDF, up to 1 MB
attachments.help: Category B, Category C and Business applicants attach the applicable supporting documents. Official limits are JPG, JPEG or PDF and no more than 1 MB.
